links.outcome: Correct primary and differential diagnosis rates of LLMs on laryngeal cases
links.effect: Correct primary diagnoses ranged 15.4% to 28.2% and differential diagnoses 15.4% to 25.6%; LLM performance was low.
links.quote: The performances of LLMs were low, with correct primary differential diagnoses ranging from 15.4% to 28.2%, and 15.4% to 25.6%, respectively.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the diagnostic and treatment recommendation accuracy of multimodal LLMs on retrospective laryngeal images and clinical histories, but does not test any deployment practices or guardrails.
